## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use the left arm to put the phone with flat black screen left of the box with coffee mug design.

Task description: Use the left arm to move the phone with its flat black screen up, left of the image center, close to the left of the coffee-cup-patterned box at the bottom of the image with an orange top and light-colored body. Align them approximately front to back.

Success criteria: Release the phone on nearby tabletop to the left of the box, approximately aligned front to back and with moderate spacing, neither too close nor too far. Both grippers must be open.

## Execution tips

- The phone is thin and close to the table. Consider spanning its short dimension to grip straight middle sections of its long edges, opening slightly wider than the body. Confirm the fingers straddle it rather than pressing only the screen or table.
- The phone is now left of the box but clearly toward the top of the image. Use the tabletop grid to compare their front-back positions so placement is not judged from left-right alignment alone.
- Since the box is higher than the phone lying flat, use the open area to the left of the box when adjusting the gripper pose, leaving room between the fingers and box wall to reduce brushing it.
- Keep the phone screen facing up and the body flat during placement. Release only after it is securely supported by the table, and minimize lateral dragging during withdrawal to avoid sliding or shifting it front to back.
